counterfactual_missing_items: Normal aortic measurements, tricuspid aortic valve
MRA neck, brain, chest, and abdomen (age 43): Unremarkable, no evidence of aneurysms
decisive_items: Doughy skin with palpable bilateral piezogenic papules
response.rationale: Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome is more likely due to the combination of joint hypermobility, skin hyperextensibility, and positive Beighton score, despite some contradictory evidence for Marfan Syndrome.

rejected.why: Lack of aneurysms on imaging contradicts Loeys-Dietz Syndrome diagnosis
Although hypermobile type is suggested, it is an append-only completion of R2 and not a distinct diagnosis in this context
